name: CheXphoto: Chest X-ray Smartphone and Synthetic Photography Dataset
description: A benchmark dataset of 10,507 photos and transformed versions of chest X-rays designed to evaluate and enhance deep learning algorithm robustness against photographic artifacts, smartphone camera distortions, and variable environmental lighting. Generated from the CheXpert validation and test sets by capturing real smartphone photos and applying synthetic optical transformations. Safeguard notice: Designed for algorithmic robustness benchmarking; not intended as a stand-alone diagnostic tool for autonomous patient care.
